chapter: Central Avenue clubs, Nordskog, Sheffield and Music Town
title: Nordskog's front-room studio, the label dispute and who played on the Ory record
summary: Nordskog recorded with a big horn in his front room; Spikes denies the suit story, and recalls Mutt Carey, Dink Johnson, Ory, Ben Borders and a pianist.

story.theme_name: In the studio: making records, then and now
story.community_name: Making records: studios, takes and the technology

blocks.x: So, at the time that you made that record, Nordskog wasn't...didn't really have the equipment to really be a recording studio, but later, he had it...

He had it in his front room...just like in here --I'd record somethin' over here. And it was just...what he had those days, you didn't have no mikes. He had just a great big horn, and when you wanted to play loud, you pushed up close to the horn. When you wanted to play soft, you get back. Heh heh heh heh.
But later he got more equipment and actually had a...
I don't know. I never made any more. I never made any more. We fell out about that record.
Yeah, it said he sued you or something 'cause...
No, he didn't. He...that's bull that...we never had no trouble about that but I got mad at him about puttin' his name on 'em.
He didn't sue you then?
No.

SPIKES - 131
Reel 4
Page 25
It said he said you ordered records and wouldn't pay for them, and he sued you.
I know that what it says.
That's not true.

No. He got all his money, and I...and I got all of my records but I didn't order but about four, five thousand, and the, uh...the, uh...I had to put my labels--my own labels on all of them. It was a lot of trouble, a lot of work and expense afterwards, you know. Then the reason I didn't make any more is because then the Black Swan Record opened up back East, you know, and I made records with Fletcher Henderson. You know, they made records for me back there, you know, my own ...... --not Kid Ory and them but Fletcher Henderson's band.
Made for you?
They recorded them. Just like I'd send them Paul Whiteman. They'd record him. Fletcher Henderson recorded them with his band but for Black Swan Records.
Oh. Your tunes?
Yeah.
The personnel on the Kid Ory record, uh, is that correct? I don't see where it's listed but I read it listed in here.
Mutt [Carey] and...
Mutt and who else? I can't find where it is...
I don't remember who was on that...Dink Johnson, Mutt, Ory, Ben Borders and, uh, I don't know, uh, let's see...Ben Borders, I don't know who it was playing piano--whether it was Buster Wilson or who.
